title: 三条定理，一套计数工具
Three theorems, one counting toolkit
entries.tex: |G|=p^a m,\ p\nmid m:\quad |P|=p^a,\quad n_p\mid m,\quad n_p\equiv1\pmod p
text: 设 G 为有限群，p 为素数，a≥1。存在 pᵃ 阶子群（西罗 p 子群）；每个 p 子群包含在某个西罗 p 子群中；所有西罗 p 子群彼此共轭；其个数 nₚ 满足上述整除与同余条件。本课简述定理结论，重点用于解题。

Let G be finite and p prime, with a≥1. Sylow p-subgroups of order pᵃ exist; every p-subgroup lies in one; all Sylow p-subgroups are conjugate; their number satisfies the displayed constraints. This course states the theorems and emphasizes applications.
warning: 右侧筛出的 nₚ 候选值只是必要条件，不能据此声称每个数都能在实际群中出现。
The candidate counts satisfy necessary conditions only; not every candidate is necessarily realized.

title: 把共轭性翻译成轨道
Conjugacy as an orbit
text: G 通过共轭作用在全部西罗 p 子群上。共轭定理说这个作用传递，稳定子正是正规化子。
G acts by conjugation on its Sylow p-subgroups. Sylow conjugacy says this action is transitive; the stabilizer is the normalizer.
proof: g·P=gPg⁻¹ 仍为同阶子群，因此仍为西罗 p 子群。
A conjugate has the same order, so it is again Sylow.
西罗共轭定理保证只有一个轨道。固定 P 的元素恰是 N_G(P)。
Conjugacy gives one orbit, and the stabilizer of P is N_G(P).
由轨道—稳定子得 nₚ=[G:N_G(P)]。又 P≤N_G(P)，指数乘法给出 nₚ∣[G:P]=m。
Orbit–stabilizer gives the formula. Since P≤N_G(P), the index multiplication formula yields nₚ∣m.
example: 这一步解释“个数整除 m”的来源；nₚ≡1 mod p 则是西罗定理的另一条约束。
This explains divisibility by m; the congruence nₚ≡1 mod p is the other Sylow constraint.

title: 唯一性等价于正规性
Uniqueness is equivalent to normality
text: 对西罗 p 子群 P，正规与唯一等价。解题时先列出同时满足“整除”和“同余”的数；若只剩 1，就立即得到正规子群。
A Sylow subgroup is normal exactly when it is unique. Intersect the divisibility and congruence conditions; if only 1 remains, normality follows.
proof: 若只有一个西罗 p 子群，任意共轭 gPg⁻¹ 必等于它，因此 P 正规。
If P is unique, every conjugate equals P, so it is normal.
若 P 正规，每个共轭都是 P；所有西罗 p 子群又都与 P 共轭，因此只能有一个。
If P is normal, all its conjugates equal P, and Sylow conjugacy gives uniqueness.

title: 完整例题：15 阶群
Worked example: groups of order 15
text: 先找两个唯一的西罗子群，再证明它们形成内部直积，最后使用互素循环群直积的结论。
Find two unique Sylow subgroups, show they give an internal direct product, then use coprime cyclic orders.
proof: n₅∣3 且 n₅≡1 mod 5，只能 n₅=1。n₃∣5 且 n₃≡1 mod 3，也只能 n₃=1。
The Sylow constraints give n₅=1 and n₃=1.
设 P,Q 分别为 3、5 阶子群。它们都正规；交集的阶同时整除 3、5，故交平凡。
Let P,Q have orders 3,5. Both are normal and their intersection is trivial by Lagrange.
映射 P×Q→G，(p,q)↦pq 为单射，因此 PQ 有 15 个元素，等于 G。
The product map is injective, so PQ has 15 elements and equals G.
于是 G≅P×Q≅C₃×C₅≅C₁₅。
Thus G≅C₃×C₅≅C₁₅.

title: 完整例题：21 阶群
Worked example: groups of order 21
text: 唯一的 7 阶子群保证 G 不是单群，但并不保证 G 交换。必须保留 n₃=7 的可能性。
The unique subgroup of order 7 makes G nonsimple, but does not force commutativity. The possibility n₃=7 must remain.
proof: n₇∣3 且 n₇≡1 mod 7，故 n₇=1。
The Sylow constraints give n₇=1.
n₃∣7 且 n₃≡1 mod 3，1 与 7 都符合。因此不能直接推出西罗 3 子群正规。
Both 1 and 7 satisfy the constraints for n₃; normality is not forced.
例如在 ℤ₇ 上取 a(x)=x+1、b(x)=2x。变换 x↦2ʲx+i（0≤j<3，0≤i<7）组成一个 21 阶群。
On ℤ₇, the maps x↦2ʲx+i, with 0≤j<3 and 0≤i<7, form a group of order 21.
bab⁻¹=a²≠a，所以此群不交换。计数条件没有排除它。
Here bab⁻¹=a²≠a, so this group is nonabelian.

title: 计数排除：30 阶群
Counting contradiction: order 30
text: 当单独一组同余条件不能强迫唯一时，把不同素数阶元素的数量放在一起计数。此例说明 30 阶群一定有非平凡真正规子群。
When individual constraints do not force uniqueness, count elements of different prime orders together. This proves that a group of order 30 has a nontrivial proper normal subgroup.
proof: n₅∣6、n₅≡1 mod 5，所以 n₅=1 或 6；n₃∣10、n₃≡1 mod 3，所以 n₃=1 或 10。
The possibilities are n₅∈{1,6} and n₃∈{1,10}.
假设两者均不为 1。不同 5 阶子群交平凡，所以共有 6×4=24 个 5 阶元素。
Assume neither is 1. Distinct order-5 subgroups intersect trivially, giving 24 elements of order 5.
同理有 10×2=20 个 3 阶元素。两种阶不同的元素互不重复，再加单位元，至少 45 个元素，矛盾。
Similarly there are 20 elements of order 3. Along with the identity this gives at least 45 elements, a contradiction.
故至少一个西罗子群唯一，因而正规。
At least one of these Sylow subgroups is unique and normal.
warning: 这类“不同子群仅在 e 相交”的计数用于素数阶子群；不能不加说明地推广到任意 pᵃ 阶子群。
Distinct prime-order subgroups intersect trivially; this argument does not automatically extend to arbitrary prime-power orders.

title: 群作用再登场：12 阶群
Group actions return: order 12
text: 西罗约束给出 n₃=1 或 4。若等于 4，让 G 作用在这四个西罗子群上，把问题送进 S₄。
Sylow gives n₃=1 or 4. In the second case, conjugation on the four Sylow subgroups gives a map to S₄.
proof: 若 n₃=1，已有正规 3 阶子群。以下设 n₃=4，并反设 G 为单群。
If n₃=1 there is a normal subgroup of order 3. Otherwise suppose, for contradiction, G is simple.
共轭作用得到 ρ:G→S₄。作用传递且四个点不止一个，因此 ρ 不平凡；核正规，由单性得核平凡。
Conjugation gives a nontrivial transitive action on four points. Simplicity forces its kernel to be trivial.
sgn∘ρ:G→C₂ 的核正规；它不可能单射（12>2），所以在单性假设下只能为平凡映射。于是 ρ(G)⊆A₄。
The sign composite cannot be injective into C₂. Simplicity forces it to be trivial, so the image lies in A₄.
两边均为 12 阶，因此 G≅A₄。但 V={e,(12)(34),(13)(24),(14)(23)} 是 A₄ 的真正规子群：乘法封闭，且共轭保持双对换类型。矛盾。
Both groups have order 12, so G≅A₄. But its identity and three double transpositions form a proper normal Klein four subgroup, a contradiction.

title: 群论解题路线
A group-theoretic problem-solving route
text: 先看元素阶与子群指数，再选作用；用轨道—稳定子、类方程和西罗计数找到结构；最后用同态与商群把结构说清楚。
Start with orders and indices, then choose an action. Use orbit–stabilizer, the class equation and Sylow counts to find structure, then express it through homomorphisms and quotients.
example: 期中复习任务：分别证明 15 阶群循环、21 阶群不一定交换、30 阶群不单。每一步注明使用哪一条定理以及它的条件。
Review tasks: prove groups of order 15 are cyclic, construct a nonabelian group of order 21, and prove groups of order 30 are not simple. State the hypotheses at each step.

question: |G|=21 时 n₇ 必须等于？
For |G|=21, what must n₇ equal?
reason: n₇∣3 且 n₇≡1 mod 7，只可能为 1。
It divides 3 and is congruent to 1 modulo 7.

question: |G|=12 时西罗条件允许的 n₃ 值为？
For order 12, what values of n₃ do the Sylow constraints allow?
reason: It divides 4 and is congruent to 1 modulo 3: 1 or 4.

question: 西罗 p 子群正规当且仅当？
A Sylow p-subgroup is normal iff?
reason: 唯一保证共轭不变；正规结合西罗共轭性保证唯一。
Uniqueness gives conjugate invariance; normality plus Sylow conjugacy gives uniqueness.

question: 30 阶群若同时 n₅=6、n₃=10，至少需要多少个元素？
If n₅=6 and n₃=10 in a group of order 30, how many elements would be required?
reason: 6×4 个 5 阶元素、10×2 个 3 阶元素，再加单位元，共 45，矛盾。
There would be 24 elements of order 5, twenty of order 3, and the identity: 45.

question: 证明：若 |G|=pq，p<q 为素数，且 p 不整除 q−1，则 G 循环。
Prove a group of order pq, with primes p<q and p∤(q−1), is cyclic.
reason: n_q∣p 且 n_q≡1 mod q，所以 n_q=1。n_p∣q，候选为 1,q；假设 p∤q−1 排除 q，故 n_p=1。两个素数阶正规子群交平凡，乘积为 G，于是 G≅C_p×C_q≅C_pq。
Sylow forces n_q=1. The candidates for n_p are 1,q; p∤(q−1) excludes q. Both Sylow subgroups are normal, intersect trivially, and form a cyclic direct product.
